approval_source.question_set: The items P01_T06_E03_STAGING_HOSTS_2026-11-10 left unset (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: P01_T06_E03_STAGING_HOSTS_2026-11-10 made the staging hosts dedicated during E03 and left four items unset.

decisions.question: How the runner reaches the hosts
decisions.selected: Open SSH at the provider console for each case, as the agent install did, and reload the firewall from its file after
decisions.rule: One case per sitting; evidence salvaged before cleanup; any ambiguous remote result stops further mutation.

decisions.question: The amd64 inert check: where and when
decisions.selected: On a native x86_64 GitHub Actions runner in a new network namespace, as a CI job
decisions.rule: Required before P02 by the method's remaining step 2. It touches no staging host and no Hetzner capacity.

decisions.question: Re-pinning the runner and its reviewed preflight to the rebuilt hosts
decisions.rule: The runner's hash changes; the P02 review follows the new hash.

decisions.question: Who performs the P02 review
decisions.selected: The founder, against the written protected-host checklist, recorded as not independent (P01_E06_NO_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_2026-11-13)
decisions.rule: No independent reviewer is available; the founder's checklist record replaces the P02 review. The out-of-repo runner must accept it, which goes in with the re-pin.

accepted_risks: Opening SSH briefly exposes the host for the sitting.
does_not_authorize: any E03 dispatch before the founder's checklist record exists
the malformed-peer case before a separate first-case decision on the wrong-key case
